listing.name: Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance (OpenXWA)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Native desktop releases using original retail installation. | Windows ZIP, Linux tar.xz, macOS ARM64 DMG Limits: Upstream says nonmultiplayer functions reimplemented; multiplayer explicitly absent. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 ZIP, Linux x86-64 tar.xz, macOS ARM64 DMG. macOS x86-64 is a source target; latest uploaded Mac package is ARM64. Original data: Multiplayer explicitly not implemented; active development, do not claim feature parity. | Complete X-Wing Alliance install, GOG/Steam layout supported Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
